title: Approval Validator Explicit Text Compatibility Fix
claim: FP-MCP-285 fixes the MCP bridge human approval validator so explicit scoped operator approval text accepted by the recorder is also accepted by validation; the existing approval artifact APPROVAL-20260704T131745827Z-219382da should be revalidated after MCP service reload.
summary: The fixed recorder created and committed approval artifact APPROVAL-20260704T131745827Z-219382da for FP-MCP-276, but validation failed with APPROVAL_TEXT_INVALID because the validator still required canonical approval text only. MCP bridge commit d45e9cc updates the validator to treat explicit scoped operator approval text as valid. Validation of the bridge passed with pnpm test. No clearance was created, no approval was consumed, no disable switch was cleared, no runner start endpoint was contacted, and no OpenCode action occurred. The MCP service must reload before live validation uses the new validator code.
caveats: The approval artifact exists and is committed, but it has not yet been validated successfully in the live MCP service.
MCP bridge service reload is required before retrying validation.
No clearance or execution step may proceed until approval validation succeeds.
boundaries: approval artifact already exists from previous step; no new approval artifact created by this checkpoint
